- Larger projects may be paid in phases or with an advance, as stated in the quote. Maintenance is billed monthly or as agreed.

chunks.text:

- Handover is confirmed by a handover record or written confirmation. If the client reports no defects within 8 days of delivery, the delivery is deemed accepted.

chunks.text:
The aim is that you are not tied to me after the work is done. Rights are split as follows:

- An exclusive right of use, unlimited in time and territory , to those parts, including the right to modify, adapt and copy them and to have other contractors maintain and extend them.
- Domain, hosting and user accounts are registered in your name wherever possible.

- Its own tools, templates and components created before the project or independently of it and reused across projects. For these you receive a non-exclusive, perpetual, royalty-free right to use and modify them within the delivered system, also after the collaboration ends.
- The right to list the project as a reference (client name, short description and screenshots) unless you request confidentiality.

- External services (hosting, AI models, email services) are subject to their providers' terms. Subscriptions are paid by the client unless agreed otherwise.
Rights pass to the client on payment of the full agreed amount. Until then the client may use the delivery for review and handover. The author's moral rights under Croatian copyright law remain with the author, but are not used to restrict your use of the delivery.

I use AI tools to develop and write faster. All code and text is reviewed before handover. Your confidential and personal data is not entered into AI tools that use it to train models.
Information obtained during the work is kept confidential, also after the collaboration ends. When I process personal data on your behalf, we sign a data processing agreement under Art. 28 of the GDPR. See the privacy policy .

chunks.title: AI search visibility (AEO) for small businesses in Croatia
chunks.heading: How to show up in ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews: a guide for small businesses in Croatia
chunks.text:
Blog
Updated 10 November 2026 – 8 min read
People increasingly type a whole question instead of two keywords: “which company does AI automation in Croatia?” or “what affordable consultants can improve my visibility in AI chat results?”. The answer comes from Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity or Copilot, with links to a few sources. Optimising for these answers is called AEO (answer engine optimisation) or GEO (generative engine optimisation). The good news for small businesses: it mostly comes down to solid SEO and clearly written content.

chunks.title: AI search visibility (AEO) for small businesses in Croatia
chunks.heading: How AI search tools choose sources
chunks.text:
When a question needs current information, AI assistants search the web and build the answer from the pages they find. So it helps to know who reads what:
- Google AI Overviews and AI Mode use Google’s index. Google says there are no additional requirements or special optimisations: a page must be indexed and eligible to be shown with a snippet.
- ChatGPT search uses OpenAI’s OAI-SearchBot. According to OpenAI’s documentation , sites that opt out of it are not shown in ChatGPT search answers. GPTBot is used for model training and is controlled separately.
- Perplexity uses its own crawler, PerplexityBot , to find and link pages in its answers.
- Microsoft Copilot relies on Bing.

chunks.title: AI search visibility (AEO) for small businesses in Croatia
chunks.heading: 1. Let the crawlers in
chunks.text: Check robots.txt and do not block Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot or PerplexityBot. If you use Cloudflare or a similar service, also check its AI bot blocking settings. You can block GPTBot to keep your content out of training and still appear in ChatGPT search.

chunks.title: AI search visibility (AEO) for small businesses in Croatia
chunks.heading: 2. Submit your site to Google and Bing / 3. Keep your Google Business Profile up to date
chunks.text:
Add the site to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools and submit your sitemap. Bing also supports IndexNow, which notifies it immediately about new or changed pages.
Google explicitly recommends keeping Business Profile information current. Category, services, service area, hours and description should match your website.

chunks.title: AI search visibility (AEO) for small businesses in Croatia
chunks.heading: 4. Answer the question straight away
chunks.text: If someone asks “how long does a website take?”, the answer belongs in the first sentence under the heading, with the explanation after it. Question-style headings and a short FAQ help both people and AI find the answer. Look at the queries in your Search Console performance report: more and more of them are full sentences.

chunks.title: AI search visibility (AEO) for small businesses in Croatia
chunks.heading: 5. Be specific
chunks.text: AI tools prefer pages that clearly say who you are, what you do, for whom, where and on what terms. “We provide innovative digital solutions” answers nothing. “We build accessible websites for municipalities, delivered in 4 to 8 weeks” answers three questions.

chunks.title: AI search visibility (AEO) for small businesses in Croatia
chunks.heading: 6. Add honest structured data
chunks.text: Google says no special schema.org markup is needed for AI features. Structured data about your business, articles and FAQs still helps search engines understand the page, as long as it matches the visible content.

chunks.title: AI search visibility (AEO) for small businesses in Croatia
chunks.heading: 7. Get mentioned beyond your own site
chunks.text: When AI compiles a list of companies, it draws on several sources: business directories, industry associations, local media, partner sites and reviews. Keep your name, location, contact and description consistent everywhere.

chunks.title: AI search visibility (AEO) for small businesses in Croatia
chunks.heading: 8. Measure
chunks.text: Traffic from Google’s AI features is included in the Search Console performance report. Visits from ChatGPT usually show up in analytics with chatgpt.com as the source. Once a month, ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google the questions your customers ask and note whether you are mentioned and which pages are cited.

chunks.title: AI search visibility (AEO) for small businesses in Croatia
chunks.heading: What does not help
chunks.text:
- Special “AI files”. Google says no new machine-readable files are needed. Files such as llms.txt do no harm, but there is no confirmation that major search tools use them to pick sources.
- Mass-produced articles. Dozens of similar texts with no new value can be treated as spam and hurt the whole site.
- Hidden text and keyword stuffing. These did not work in classic SEO either.

chunks.title: AI search visibility (AEO) for small businesses in Croatia
chunks.heading: Limiting what AI shows
chunks.text:
Google supports nosnippet, data-nosnippet and max-snippet to limit what appears in results and AI features, while noindex removes a page from search entirely. For OpenAI, access is set in robots.txt, separately for search and for training.
MangAI builds fast websites with clean structured data and content written around real customer questions. Send an enquiry for a review of your site’s visibility.

chunks.title: AI search visibility (AEO) for small businesses in Croatia
chunks.heading: Sources / Common questions
chunks.text:
- AI features and your website, Google Search Central
- Overview of OpenAI Crawlers, OpenAI
- Perplexity Crawlers, Perplexity
What is AEO?
AEO (answer engine optimisation) means making your content easy for AI assistants and AI search features, such as ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews, to find, understand and cite. It mostly comes down to good SEO and clear answers to customer questions.
Do I need special optimisation for Google AI Overviews?
According to Google, no. A page must be indexed and eligible for a snippet, and the usual SEO best practices apply.
How do I appear in ChatGPT search?
Do not block OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt, make sure the site is indexed and answers questions clearly. Blocking GPTBot for training does not affect search visibility.
